title: UGREEN’s 45W world travel adapter is back to its Prime Day low
summary: UGREEN’s 45W 6-port travel adapter is down to $27.99 on Amazon, returning to its all-time low for your global trips.
body: UGREEN’s 45W 6-Port Universal Travel Plug Adapter is the kind of gear that makes a lot of sense for anyone who travels with multiple devices, and there’s a good deal on it right now on Amazon. It packs charging and plug conversion into a single compact unit, so you can carry a single adapter instead of a pile of separate chargers and region-specific plugs. See the deal at Amazon

title: Anker Nano 13-in-1 USB-C dock gets a 20% Amazon price drop
summary: Anker’s Nano Laptop Docking Station drops to $119.99 on Amazon, giving you a 13-in-1 dock and travel hub in one.
body: The Anker Nano Laptop Docking Station is down to $119.99 on Amazon right now, which saves you $30 off its $149.99 retail price. That’s a 20% discount relative to the RRP, and it’s a solid chance to grab a dock that also doubles as a travel hub without paying full price. See the deal at Amazon
